SR2E.Settings.typedDice.Name: Typed physical-dice results
SR2E.Settings.typedDice.Hint: Who may type the successes of real dice rolled at the table in a roll window instead of letting Foundry roll. The card is marked as typed, and nothing from it applies by itself: the GM applies.
